name: Vortex IQ
description:
VortexIQ is an AI operating system for ecommerce. This connector gives Claude read-only access to the signed-in user's VortexIQ workspace, so you can ask about your store's health and pull your data without leaving the chat.

Ask Claude to:
• Pull store KPIs and trends (orders, sales, AOV, refunds) for BigCommerce, Shopify and more, across today / 7 / 30 / 90 days
• List and read Store Audit findings and health scores, and the Kanban health-fix backlog
• Review active Nerve Centre alerts and a 24-hour incident summary
• Look up Brand DNA voice and tone profiles while drafting content
• List generated reports, Vortex Memory files, and Ask VIQ conversation history
• See connected integrations, the KPI library, and metric definitions

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vortex IQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vortex IQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.vortexiq.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vortex IQ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vortex IQ lists 29 MCP tools, including get_alert_summary, get_ask_viq_conversation, get_brand_profile, get_dashboard_activity_feed, get_integration_kpis, get_kanban_board, get_kanban_fix_items, get_kanban_fix_status, get_nerve_integration_counts, get_store_audit_report, get_store_audit_status, and list_alert_activity.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vortex IQ?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Vortex IQ in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Vortex IQ MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vortex IQ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vortex IQ is developed by VortexIQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
